title: CAIP expertise catalog — one topic file

category.description: The folder this file lives in. See CATEGORIES.md.

topic.description: The file's own name, without .json. Lowercase, dashes.

title.description: How a human says the topic.

stack.description: The stack keys this pack serves, '/'-separated aliases. Matched against a container's declared framework/language, normalized (lowercase, separators dropped).

path.description: Repository-relative folder or file holding the pack. Omit when the pack is the repository root. Never absolute, never '..'.

license.description: SPDX id, or 'none' when the repository carries no LICENSE file. 'none' is allowed but must be read before relying on it.

description.description: What the pack teaches, in one sentence. Not marketing: a maintainer's note.

verifiedAt.description: ISO date the entry was last checked against the GitHub API.
